_readme: Routes whose response is allowed to differ from the Ninja baseline, with the
reason. Every entry is a deliberate decision, not a silenced failure — if a
route is not listed here it must match exactly.
mode 'superset': the new response must contain every key of the baseline with
the same values, and may add keys. Safe only where the consumer reads named
fields and ignores the rest, which is how both Angular clients read JSON.

/api/v1/auth/me/.reason: One endpoint now serves both frontends, so it returns the union of the reporting and portal field sets. The portal's 17 keys are all present and unchanged; the 25 additions are report_moe's own flags, which the portal does not read.
